description: Premium between Hyperliquid perp (mid) and KRX price, its usual level (5-day regular-session median) and the net left after costs on the gap beyond that level. net.netPct subtracts fees, tax, FX, funding, order-book slippage for notionalKrw (net.costs.slippage, net.fills: volume-weighted fill prices per leg) and the price move during the gap between the two orders (net.costs.latency = 1-minute volatility × √(lagSec/60)). net.depthLimited / net.maxNotionalKrw: the visible book can fill less than notionalKrw. oracle.active: oracle-anomaly window (thin print moved the oracle); numbers stay on the real book, oracle.warning flags liquidation risk. All assets if asset is omitted

asset.description: SMSN=Samsung Electronics, SKHX=SK hynix, HYUNDAI=Hyundai Motor, SKHY=SK hynix ADR (vs 0.1 common share)

notionalKrw.description: Trade size per leg in KRW (default 10000000)
